records.title: World Bank approves US$215.9 million Burkina Faso Agricultural Transformation Project
records.summary: The project supports agricultural productivity, value chains, processing, market access and private investment in Burkina Faso.

records.title: World Bank approves US$40 million SAVIG programme in Sierra Leone
records.summary: SAVIG supports sustainable agricultural value-chain intensification, productivity, private investment and job creation.

records.title: FAO highlights Nigeria's ₦6.5 trillion NASIP agrifood investment plan
records.summary: FAO reports that MAFAP analysis helped guide more than one-third of Nigeria's 2026–2027 agrifood investment plan through evidence-based public-spending and policy optimization.

records.title: CGIAR THRIVE highlights soil restoration and farm diversification in Ethiopia
records.summary: THRIVE connects soil restoration, crop diversification, resilient planting material and inclusive markets as pathways toward resilient agrifood systems.

records.title: CGIAR THRIVE highlights soil restoration and farm diversification in Kenya
records.summary: THRIVE connects soil restoration, crop diversification, resilient planting material and inclusive markets as pathways toward resilient agrifood systems.

records.title: CGIAR THRIVE highlights soil restoration and farm diversification in Uganda
records.summary: THRIVE connects soil restoration, crop diversification, resilient planting material and inclusive markets as pathways toward resilient agrifood systems.

records.title: IITA study examines climate-smart agriculture practices across Mali
records.summary: A study covering 3,709 households and 8,391 plots across six regions examines climate-smart agriculture practices and evidence relevant to climate-resilient farming.

records.title: IITA calls for scaling agricultural research into transformation across Africa
records.summary: IITA highlighted the need to connect agricultural research with finance, policy and delivery, citing scaling examples including heat-tolerant wheat and aflatoxin management.

records.title: World Bank approves US$500 million Ghana Market Access and Connectivity Project
records.summary: The project will improve rural road connectivity, strengthen agricultural value chains and help farmers reach larger markets more efficiently.

records.title: Angola launches AgriConnect Compact for food security, jobs and agricultural growth
records.summary: Angola's AgriConnect Compact brings government, private sector, financial institutions and farmer organizations together around agricultural value-chain investment and reform.

records.title: Zimbabwe takes US$1.65 billion agrifood investment portfolio to FAO forum
records.summary: Zimbabwe will present investment cases covering maize, soyabean, blueberries, dairy and the Dam as an Economic driver at the 2026 Hand-in-Hand Investment Forum.

records.title: World Bank approves US$116 million second phase of Guinea Commercial Agriculture Development Project
records.summary: The project aims to commercialize agriculture, attract private investment, expand employment and strengthen key agricultural value chains.

records.title: World Bank approves US$500 million Nigeria AGROW project
records.summary: AGROW targets smallholder productivity and value chains including rice, maize, cassava and soybeans, with matching grants, market access, research, extension and digital advisory services.

records.title: Senegal expands agricultural insurance coverage against drought and rainfall shocks
records.summary: World Bank results report more than 835,000 farmers and breeders gained index-based agricultural insurance coverage against drought and rainfall shocks in 2025.

records.title: The Gambia expands improved seed and fertilizer distribution through digital systems
records.summary: More than 57,000 farmers received improved rice and maize seed through a digitally managed distribution platform, alongside fertilizer and climate-smart farming support.

records.title: Guinea strengthens warehouse receipts and agricultural risk management
records.summary: World Bank results report 100 approved warehouses under a strengthened warehouse receipt system and an index-based insurance scheme protecting farmers and breeders from drought and poor rainfall.

records.title: AICCRA–FSRP4 expands climate-smart agriculture innovation in Ethiopia
records.summary: A new regional initiative is scaling climate-smart technologies and climate information services, with Ethiopia among the participating countries.

records.title: AICCRA–FSRP4 expands climate-smart agriculture innovation in Ghana
records.summary: The initiative is designed to connect agricultural research with farmers by expanding climate-smart technologies and climate information services in Ghana.

records.title: AICCRA–FSRP4 expands climate-smart agriculture innovation in Kenya
records.summary: Kenya is among the countries covered by the regional initiative scaling climate-smart agricultural innovations and climate information services.

records.title: AICCRA–FSRP4 expands climate-smart agriculture innovation in Mali
records.summary: The initiative includes Mali in efforts to bridge agricultural research and farmer adoption through climate-smart technologies and climate information services.

records.title: AICCRA–FSRP4 expands climate-smart agriculture innovation in Senegal
records.summary: Senegal is included in a regional effort to scale climate-smart agricultural innovations and climate information services and connect research with farmers.

records.title: AICCRA–FSRP4 expands climate-smart agriculture innovation in Zambia
records.summary: Zambia is included in the regional initiative scaling climate-smart agricultural technologies and climate information services for farmers and food-system actors.

records.title: Senegal AgriConnect Compact
records.summary: Senegal's national AgriConnect Compact targets grains, horticulture and livestock while mobilizing public and private investment in agricultural infrastructure, services and value chains.

records.title: Côte d'Ivoire e-Agriculture digital marketplace
records.summary: The World Bank reports that Côte d'Ivoire's e-Agriculture project benefited more than 400,000 people in selected agricultural value chains through improved market access and information.

records.title: Benin Digital Rural Transformation agricultural machinery platform
records.summary: Benin's digital rural transformation work includes platforms for agricultural machinery management, crop advisory services and farm monitoring using geospatial data.

records.title: Cameroon agricultural e-voucher system
records.summary: Cameroon's digital transformation project enrolled producers into an electronic voucher system supporting fertilizer and seed subsidies.

records.title: Senegal agricultural warehouse receipt and market infrastructure
records.summary: Senegal strengthened its Warehouse Receipt System and approved 100 warehouses, alongside measures improving agricultural market access and climate-risk management.

records.title: The Gambia agricultural matching-grant programme
records.summary: The Gambia's matching-grant programme has supported agribusinesses, farmers' organizations and SMEs while mobilizing private investment and creating jobs.

records.title: Benin to present agrifood investment opportunities at FAO Hand-in-Hand Forum
records.summary: FAO announced that Benin is among the African countries presenting government-led agrifood investment opportunities at the 2026 Hand-in-Hand Investment Forum in Rome.

records.title: Cabo Verde to present agrifood investment opportunities at FAO Hand-in-Hand Forum
records.summary: FAO announced that Cabo Verde is among the African countries presenting government-led agrifood investment opportunities at the 2026 Hand-in-Hand Investment Forum in Rome.

records.title: Côte d'Ivoire to present agrifood investment opportunities at FAO Hand-in-Hand Forum
records.summary: FAO announced that Côte d'Ivoire is among the African countries presenting government-led agrifood investment opportunities at the 2026 Hand-in-Hand Investment Forum in Rome.

records.title: Democratic Republic of the Congo to present agrifood investment opportunities at FAO Hand-in-Hand Forum
records.summary: FAO announced that Democratic Republic of the Congo is among the African countries presenting government-led agrifood investment opportunities at the 2026 Hand-in-Hand Investment Forum in Rome.

records.title: Djibouti to present agrifood investment opportunities at FAO Hand-in-Hand Forum
records.summary: FAO announced that Djibouti is among the African countries presenting government-led agrifood investment opportunities at the 2026 Hand-in-Hand Investment Forum in Rome.

records.title: Eswatini to present agrifood investment opportunities at FAO Hand-in-Hand Forum
records.summary: FAO announced that Eswatini is among the African countries presenting government-led agrifood investment opportunities at the 2026 Hand-in-Hand Investment Forum in Rome.

records.title: Liberia to present agrifood investment opportunities at FAO Hand-in-Hand Forum
records.summary: FAO announced that Liberia is among the African countries presenting government-led agrifood investment opportunities at the 2026 Hand-in-Hand Investment Forum in Rome.

records.title: Madagascar to present agrifood investment opportunities at FAO Hand-in-Hand Forum
records.summary: FAO announced that Madagascar is among the African countries presenting government-led agrifood investment opportunities at the 2026 Hand-in-Hand Investment Forum in Rome.

records.title: Malawi to present agrifood investment opportunities at FAO Hand-in-Hand Forum
records.summary: FAO announced that Malawi is among the African countries presenting government-led agrifood investment opportunities at the 2026 Hand-in-Hand Investment Forum in Rome.

records.title: Mozambique to present agrifood investment opportunities at FAO Hand-in-Hand Forum
records.summary: FAO announced that Mozambique is among the African countries presenting government-led agrifood investment opportunities at the 2026 Hand-in-Hand Investment Forum in Rome.

records.title: Rwanda to present agrifood investment opportunities at FAO Hand-in-Hand Forum
records.summary: FAO announced that Rwanda is among the African countries presenting government-led agrifood investment opportunities at the 2026 Hand-in-Hand Investment Forum in Rome.

records.title: Zambia to present agrifood investment opportunities at FAO Hand-in-Hand Forum
records.summary: FAO announced that Zambia is among the African countries presenting government-led agrifood investment opportunities at the 2026 Hand-in-Hand Investment Forum in Rome.

records.headline: Zambia positions four agrifood value chains for 2026 Hand-in-Hand investment
records.summary: FAO reports Zambia refined bankable investment priorities across beef, common beans, soybeans and honey ahead of the 2026 Hand-in-Hand Investment Forum.

records.headline: Government and FAO launch initiative to catalyse transformative and sustainable food systems in Zambia
records.summary: Zambia and FAO launched a new initiative in September 2026 focused on transforming food systems and strengthening sustainable agrifood development.

records.headline: Kapenta Day 2026 strengthens partnerships and market opportunities in Zambia's kapenta value chain
records.summary: FAO reports that fishers, processors, traders, cooperatives, finance institutions and other stakeholders met in Mpulungu to strengthen market opportunities for the kapenta value chain.

records.headline: Eastern Africa Hand-in-Hand Investment Forum convenes in Kigali
records.summary: FAO's Eastern Africa forum in Kigali brought governments, investors, financial institutions, agribusinesses and partners together to showcase investment-ready agrifood opportunities and strengthen regional cooperation.

records.headline: Kapenta Day 2026 strengthens partnerships and market opportunities in Zambia's kapenta value chain
records.summary: More than 100 fishers, processors, traders, cooperatives, financial institutions and other stakeholders gathered in Mpulungu to strengthen partnerships, market access, sustainable fisheries and value addition.

records.headline: Government and FAO launch new initiative to catalyse transformative and sustainable food systems in Zambia
records.summary: A new two-year initiative focuses on food security, nutrition, resilience, sustainable livelihoods, climate-smart agriculture, food safety, market development and livestock traceability.

records.headline: Zambia expands practical agricultural learning through Farmer Field Schools
records.summary: FAO and government partners established Farmer Field School activities for vulnerable farming households across six districts, with a minimum of 90 schools planned and capacity for up to 2,700 farmers.

records.headline: Zambia advances agricultural governance, plant health regulations and digital information systems
records.summary: FAO-supported technical workshops advanced plant health regulations and assessment of the Zambia Integrated Agricultural Management Information System, with emphasis on reliable agricultural data and digital decision-making.

records.headline: FAO launches second call for Zambia SIFAZ Matching Grant Facility
records.summary: The SIFAZ Matching Grant Facility supports eligible Zambian farmers, cooperatives and agribusinesses in mechanization, input acquisition and marketing, commodity aggregation and green enterprises; the 2026 call offered grants from €400 to €60,000.

records.headline: Zambia strengthens agricultural weather knowledge through extension officer training
records.summary: FAO-supported training in Southern Zambia is helping extension officers turn weather and climate information into practical guidance for farmers.

records.headline: FAO highlights Angola's role in Southern Africa irrigation and agrifood investment initiative
records.summary: Angola is included in FAO's 2026 Southern Africa regional investment initiative, with community reservoirs and renewable-energy irrigation among the targeted interventions.

records.headline: FAO highlights Mozambique in Southern Africa irrigation and rice investment plans
records.summary: Mozambique is identified in FAO's 2026 regional initiative for irrigation infrastructure, rice production and agroprocessing opportunities.

records.headline: FAO highlights Malawi in Southern Africa irrigation and rice investment plans
records.summary: Malawi is identified in FAO's 2026 regional initiative for community reservoirs, irrigation and rice value-chain development.

records.headline: Zambia included in FAO regional mechanization investment initiative
records.summary: FAO's Southern Africa 2026 initiative includes Zambia among countries targeted for mechanization hire-service hubs and improved machinery access.

records.headline: Zimbabwe included in FAO regional mechanization and agroprocessing investment initiative
records.summary: FAO's Southern Africa 2026 initiative identifies Zimbabwe for mechanization services, wheat production and soybean agroprocessing opportunities.

records.title: FAO turns Ghana soil data into practical farm-management action
records.summary: FAO and the CSIR–Soil Research Institute are helping farmers in Ghana's Upper West Region translate soil assessments into practical sustainable soil-management decisions under RECSOIL.

records.title: FAO trains extension agents for climate-smart soybean farms in northern Ghana
records.summary: Fifty agricultural extension agents were trained to establish 100 demonstration farms and support about 10,000 smallholder soybean farmers across six districts.

records.title: FAO and EU support Feed Ghana programme with 150,000 poultry birds
records.summary: FAO and the European Union provided poultry birds, feed and training to farmers in northern Ghana as part of efforts to raise local production and reduce import dependence.

records.title: FAO and Ghana strengthen sustainable Fall Armyworm management
records.summary: FAO support is strengthening integrated pest management, farmer training, demonstration trials and biological-control capacity for Fall Armyworm in Ghana.

records.title: FAO strengthens Ghana soil laboratory capacity through SoilFER training
records.summary: Thirty-eight laboratory technicians and experts were trained on harmonized soil-analysis methods to strengthen reliable soil data generation for sustainable agriculture.

records.title: FAO advances Earth Observation and farmer registries for crop monitoring in Africa
records.summary: An ESTELLA training in Accra is strengthening technical capacity for Earth Observation, farmer registries and crop-data validation to support early warning and climate-risk management.

records.title: Ghana Cocoa Monitor launches steering committee to strengthen cocoa-sector coordination
records.summary: The Ghana Cocoa Monitor is bringing stakeholders together around data sharing, transparency, sustainability and evidence-based action in Ghana's cocoa value chain.

records.title: Regional strategy targets cocoa swollen shoot virus disease in West Africa
records.summary: A five-year regional strategy emphasizes farm rehabilitation, monitoring, research and collaboration to protect cocoa production and rural livelihoods.

records.title: Ghana advances roadmap to reduce antimicrobial use in poultry and aquaculture
records.summary: Stakeholders developed a draft national roadmap under RENOFARM to improve disease prevention, veterinary services and responsible antimicrobial use.

records.title: Ghana graduates 210 poultry farmers through Farmer Field Schools on antimicrobial resistance
records.summary: Farmer Field School participants strengthened poultry biosecurity and responsible antimicrobial-use practices under FAO-supported programming.

records.headline: Kenya opens GEF-7 FOLUR direct beneficiary grants for coffee, maize and nature-based livelihoods
records.summary: FAO opened a call for direct beneficiary grants under the GEF-7 FOLUR Mt. Elgon Project, supporting eligible local organizations in Western Kenya working on coffee, maize and nature-based livelihood enterprises.

records.headline: Vihiga County receives drone to strengthen GIS mapping and evidence-based planning
records.summary: A new drone handed to Vihiga County under the EU-FAO Digital Land Governance Programme will support spatial data collection, land-use planning, disaster preparedness and evidence-based decision-making.

records.headline: Kenya launches National Soil Partnership, Soil Laboratory Network and Soil Doctors Programme
records.summary: Kenya launched three national initiatives under SoilFER to strengthen soil data, laboratory systems, technical capacity and farmer access to practical soil-management advice.

records.headline: FAO and Kenya National Bureau of Statistics begin agricultural data validation across 14 Lake Region counties
records.summary: FAO and KNBS began validating agricultural data from 14 Lake Region Economic Block counties for KIAMIS and county open-data systems, with a focus on reliable, regularly updated agricultural information.

records.headline: FAO hands over digital equipment to strengthen Farmer Field Schools and climate-resilient agriculture in 14 Lake Region counties
records.summary: FAO provided digital equipment and learning materials to county focal points and Farmer Field School facilitators under TUNZA, supporting climate information, production data and practical farmer learning.

records.headline: Kenya and Tanzania strengthen cross-border cooperation on animal health and livestock trade
records.summary: Kenya and Tanzania agreed to strengthen disease surveillance, information sharing and safe livestock movement and trade under the EU-funded PLACE programme.

records.headline: FAO strengthens agrometeorological advisory services for climate-smart agriculture in Kenya
records.summary: FAO's TUNZA project trained 56 trainers from 14 counties to interpret climate forecasts and translate them into practical crop- and livestock-specific advice for farmers.

records.headline: Young Climate Champions use 4K Clubs to promote nutrition-sensitive climate-smart agriculture in Kenya
records.summary: School 4K Clubs in Kajiado and Embu are demonstrating water-efficient gardens, poultry production and climate-smart practices that improve nutrition, learning and household resilience.

records.headline: Uganda launches US$31 million REDD+ Results-Based Payment Project
records.summary: Uganda launched a Green Climate Fund project that will reinvest verified-emission-reduction payments in landscape restoration, sustainable land management, agroforestry, resilient livelihoods and stronger climate systems.

records.headline: Uganda launches Green Roots Women's Farm Labs for women-led green enterprises
records.summary: FAO and Uganda's Ministry of Gender launched a two-year initiative to connect women-led micro-enterprises with finance, markets, technology and business-development services.

records.headline: EU-funded FOSTER project strengthens food security and resilience in Karamoja
records.summary: The EUR5 million FOSTER project supported 16,000 households and more than 80,000 people, combining Farmer Field Schools, productive assets, grants, finance links, climate information and water infrastructure.

records.headline: Uganda flags off first-ever export of canned pineapple to China
records.summary: Uganda's first commercial canned-pineapple export to China linked more than 1,500 smallholder farmers to a processing market and marked progress in agro-processing and value addition.

records.headline: Eastern Africa agrifood investment forum highlights Uganda opportunities
records.summary: Uganda joined Eastern African countries at FAO's 2026 Hand-in-Hand forum in Kigali to showcase investment-ready agrifood opportunities and strengthen partnerships with investors and financial institutions.

records.headline: Uganda strengthens climate resilience through sustainable land management and agroforestry investment
records.summary: FAO's Uganda REDD+ results-based programme links climate finance with sustainable land management, agroforestry, restoration and resilient food systems.

records.headline: Nigeria's 2026 Hand-in-Hand portfolio totals US$3.2 billion across six agrifood value chains
records.summary: FAO's Nigeria 2026 investment profile presents US$3.2 billion in investment cases covering tomato, cassava, maize, dairy, fisheries and aquaculture, and beef feedlots.

records.headline: Nigeria advances agrifood systems and climate-action convergence
records.summary: Government, UN agencies and partners renewed efforts to align food-systems transformation with climate action and investment planning at a high-level Abuja workshop.

records.headline: FAO supports more than 200,000 vulnerable people with farming inputs in northeast Nigeria
records.summary: FAO and partners supported vulnerable households with agricultural inputs as the rainy season began, helping restore food production and livelihoods in conflict-affected areas.

records.headline: Nigeria's NASIP 2026–2027 uses evidence to guide ₦6.5 trillion agrifood spending
records.summary: FAO's MAFAP programme supported analysis that helped inform Nigeria's two-year National Agrifood Systems Investment Plan and improve allocation of agrifood public expenditure.

records.headline: FAO launches Nigeria Emergency and Resilience Plan 2026–2028
records.summary: FAO launched a multi-year emergency and resilience plan aimed at protecting livelihoods, restoring food production and strengthening resilience among crisis-affected communities.

records.headline: Côte d'Ivoire prepares agrifood investment cases for FAO's 2026 Rome forum
records.summary: Côte d'Ivoire is preparing nine agrifood investment cases under three integrated agro-industrial pole programmes for presentation to investors at the 2026 Hand-in-Hand forum.
records.source: Ministry of Agriculture of Côte d'Ivoire

records.headline: Côte d'Ivoire launches preparations for its National Agriculture Census
records.summary: The government and FAO launched work on the National Agriculture Census to improve agricultural statistics, planning and investment decisions.
records.source: Ministry of Agriculture of Côte d'Ivoire

records.headline: Côte d'Ivoire sets new roadmap for next-generation agriculture
records.summary: The Ministry of Agriculture outlined a leadership and modernization roadmap aimed at strengthening agricultural transformation, innovation and investment.
records.source: Ministry of Agriculture of Côte d'Ivoire

records.headline: SAGA 2 strengthens climate adaptation and sustainable agriculture in Côte d'Ivoire
records.summary: FAO and partners reviewed SAGA 2 results and prospects for scaling climate adaptation approaches and resilient agricultural livelihoods in Côte d'Ivoire.
records.source: Ministry of Agriculture of Côte d'Ivoire

records.headline: Côte d'Ivoire advances warehouse-receipt systems and agricultural market access
records.summary: The Ministry of Agriculture highlighted efforts around warehouse receipts and market systems to strengthen transparency and financing across agricultural value chains.
records.source: Ministry of Agriculture of Côte d'Ivoire

records.headline: Japan and Ethiopia sign ETB 375 million grant to modernize rice-sector mechanization
records.summary: Ethiopia and Japan signed a grant agreement to finance combine harvesters, tractors, rice mills and land-preparation equipment for the rice sector.

records.headline: Ethiopia prepares four investment-ready agrifood cases for 2026 Hand-in-Hand Forum
records.summary: Ethiopia is presenting mechanization, animal feed, ranching and grandparent-stock poultry opportunities with a combined investment requirement of US$744.6 million.

records.headline: FAO scales emergency agricultural and livestock resilience support in Ethiopia
records.summary: FAO reports continuing needs linked to drought, flooding, conflict, economic shocks, pests and disease, with emergency agricultural and livestock assistance planned for vulnerable communities.

records.headline: Ethiopia advances youth-led agrifood transformation
records.summary: FAO and partners convened Ethiopian youth leaders, policymakers and other stakeholders to translate agrifood-system dialogue into national action focused on climate resilience and inclusive innovation.

records.headline: Ethiopia and FAO advance national agrifood transformation roadmap
records.summary: FAO and Ethiopia's Ministry of Agriculture have been aligning the Global Roadmap's actions with national priorities for food security, climate resilience and agrifood transformation.

records.headline: Sierra Leone prepares US$760 million agrifood investment portfolio for 2026 Hand-in-Hand Forum
records.summary: FAO's 2026 investment profile presents four Sierra Leone opportunities in rice, cassava, poultry feed and palm oil, with total proposed investment of US$760 million.

records.headline: Sierra Leone targets major rice import substitution through new investment case
records.summary: The rice investment case targets mechanization, milling, storage, aggregation and financing, with an objective of reducing imports while raising yields and milling utilization.

records.headline: Sierra Leone develops cassava processing and formal export opportunities
records.summary: FAO's cassava case targets production clusters, processing for high-quality cassava flour and starch, logistics and financing to formalize regional trade.

records.headline: Sierra Leone publishes 2024 Annual Agricultural Survey microdata
records.summary: Microdata from the 2024 Annual Agricultural Survey are now publicly available through the national NADA platform, strengthening evidence for agricultural policy-making.

records.headline: Sierra Leone Agrifood Investor Summit mobilizes private capital for priority value chains
records.summary: More than 25 international and regional investors and over 60 domestic agrifood firms participated in the 2025 summit, covering rice, cassava, cocoa, cashew, poultry, feed grains, forestry and palm oil.

records.headline: Sierra Leone advances Feed Salone implementation for aggregation, processing and marketing
records.summary: The Feed Salone Pillar 3 implementation plan sets 2028 targets for rice milling, egg production, onion cultivation, cassava processing and cashew quality and production.

records.headline: Sierra Leone and African Development Bank strengthen cooperation on Feed Salone
records.summary: The Ministry of Agriculture reported discussions with the African Development Bank on cooperation and ongoing investment in Sierra Leone's agricultural sector.
records.source: Ministry of Agriculture and Food Security

records.headline: Angola presents US$1.17 billion of agrifood investment opportunities for 2026
records.summary: FAO's Angola investment profile presents four major cases in coffee, avocado, palm oil and soybean with a combined proposed investment of US$1.17 billion.

records.headline: FAO validates Angola avocado, citrus and palm-oil value-chain studies
records.summary: FAO and Angola's government are using value-chain studies to guide sustainable investment, processing, logistics and export readiness in avocado, citrus and palm oil.

records.headline: Angola focuses on innovation and partnerships to improve access to nutritious food
records.summary: A World Food Day event in Luanda highlighted the need to connect agricultural production with research, markets and household nutrition.

records.headline: Angola strengthens food-balance-sheet capacity for evidence-based policy
records.summary: FAO and the Ministry of Agriculture and Forestry conducted Food Balance Sheet training and compilation work to strengthen agricultural and food-policy evidence.

records.headline: Angola builds community capacity for resilient agrifood systems
records.summary: FAO and Angola's Ministry of Environment are strengthening the skills of farmers, technicians and community leaders in sustainable land, water and food-production practices.

records.headline: Angola strengthens fruit-fly surveillance to protect horticultural trade
records.summary: FAO highlighted surveillance and management of invasive fruit flies affecting mango, citrus and avocado production, with implications for livelihoods, food security and exports.

records.headline: Angola advances agrifood investment and water security
records.summary: Angola showcased agrifood transformation and water-security priorities during World Food Forum activities, reinforcing agriculture's role in economic diversification.

records.headline: Angola and Brazil deepen cooperation on agricultural investment and technology
records.summary: Angola and Brazil strengthened cooperation around private investment, technology transfer, agricultural research, mechanization, training and agribusiness value chains.

records.headline: Benin targets rice, poultry and soybean in 2026 agrifood investment agenda
records.summary: FAO identifies rice, poultry and soybean among Benin's priority value chains for the 2026 Hand-in-Hand Investment Forum.

records.headline: Benin launches implementation support for its third-generation national agricultural investment plan
records.summary: FAO and Benin's Ministry of Agriculture, Livestock and Fisheries launched support for implementing the third generation of PNIASAN and planning priority investments.

records.headline: Benin's 2026 cereal planting season gets underway
records.summary: FAO GIEWS reports that 2026 cereal planting was underway, with maize and rice planting completed in southern and central areas and northern planting beginning later in the season.

records.headline: Benin cereal prices remain below year-earlier levels in early 2026
records.summary: FAO reports stable local rice and maize prices from January to April 2026, with rice about 10 percent below year-earlier levels and maize 25–35 percent lower.

records.headline: Benin faces localized flood and insecurity risks alongside favorable crop conditions
records.summary: FAO reports generally favorable rainfall prospects for much of Benin but warns of localized flooding and continued insecurity disrupting agricultural activity in northern departments.
